name: SVS Ventures Ltd.
summary: SVS Ventures Ltd. functions as a real estate company specializing in property development and management. Its broad scope of projects encompasses residential developments such as housing schemes, co-operative societies, and estates, alongside commercial offerings including shopping and office complexes, and expansive mixed-use townships. The company also undertakes the development of agricultural properties, holiday resorts, hotels, and motels. Established on December 21, 2015, the firm's primary operations are based in Ahmedabad, India.
